# LTU DARPA SubT cave asset

`cave_world.usdc` and the textures in this directory were converted from
`worlds/models/cave_world/meshes/cave_world.obj` in
<https://github.com/LTU-RAI/darpa_subt_worlds> at commit
`a15a1107e638eae090335d2d6f36c623439aaa7f`.

The source repository and its upstream
<https://github.com/LTU-RAI/gazebo_cave_world> identify the cave world as MIT
licensed. The source model metadata credits Louise Poubel and Cole Biesemeyer;
the project README credits Anton Koval, Christoforos Kanellakis, Emil Vidmark,
Jakub Haluska, and George Nikolakopoulos and notes that the environment combines
DARPA-provided tiles with custom models. The retained license is in `LICENSE`.

Conversion used Isaac Sim 6.0.1 `omni.kit.asset_converter`. See
`cave_world.usdc.provenance.json` for hashes. No Gazebo physics, plugins, or
lights were imported.
